limits: This ablation holds the same physical candidate HNSW index, indexed symbol-version6 metadata, symbol provider, infrastructure and container fixed. It changes the retrieval/selector/strategy module group only; it does not isolate symbol extraction changes from independent index construction.
Managed server restarts precede each run; process state, persistent-index loading and external query-vector variation remain possible sources of repeat variation.
Both rerankers, rewrite and query cache remain disabled. This is not an evaluation of enabled adaptive rerank utility or of downstream agent success.
Model usage is observed administration counters, not definitive billing or per-request ownership. The contiguous four-suite window includes late observations crossing suite boundaries.
Benchmark truth is unchanged exposed development regression evidence, not untouched validation.

Pass1 completed all scored suites, then its initial overly broad metadata guard rejected normal checkpoint chain-count changes. The server stopped and pass2 resumed with every materialized blob/chunk/symbol/lexical/vector count and exact compatible profile held fixed; chain/membership changes are preserved separately. The post-run1 metadata observation was taken read-only after the next managed restart.
